description: Product Management skills for AI agents

plugins.name: pm-skills
plugins.description: 68 PM skills (30 phase + 11 foundation + 12 utility + 15 tool) plus 6 sub-agents (pm-critic, pm-skill-auditor, pm-changelog-curator, pm-release-conductor, pm-workflow-orchestrator, pm-skill-router) covering the full product lifecycle. v2.34.0 ships what survived a test against a no-skill control: two planned AI skills lost and were not built, and their winning decisions went into deliver-prd 3.1.0, covering runs per case, content the model must not obey, output that must not reach a lower-access audience, and rate requirements that stay rates until a designed sample backs them. The library samples and skill examples now mark the figures they invent with [fictional]. No new skills; catalog stays 68 skills / 6 sub-agents. Full release history: https://github.com/product-on-purpose/pm-skills/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
